label: Кабинет
description: A 10-sentence usage card for кабинет (office; study).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Кабинет' is the masculine nominative subject of the sentence. 'Нашего директора' is the genitive of possession showing whose office it is. A basic identification pattern.

Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'В кабинет' uses the masculine inanimate accusative, identical to the nominative, after 'в' to mark the destination. 'Войдите' is the polite imperative. A common office instruction.

Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В кабинете' uses the masculine prepositional 'кабинете' after 'в' to show where the doctor is. 'Своём' agrees in the prepositional. The default 'is in the office' pattern.

missions.phrase: Он вышел из кабинета пять минут назад.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of source. 'Из кабинета' uses the masculine genitive 'кабинета' after 'из' to mark where he came from. 'Пять минут назад' is the time phrase. The mirror of 'в кабинет'.

Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Кабинета' is the masculine genitive after 'окна', linking the windows to the office. 'Выходят' agrees with the neuter plural subject 'окна'. Useful for describing rooms.

Strategic focus: Dative goal after 'к'. 'К кабинету' uses the masculine dative 'кабинету' to show where I walked up to. 'Начальника' is the genitive of possession. A natural approach-the-door sentence.

Strategic focus: Nominative subject with instrumental. 'Кабинет' is the masculine nominative subject. 'Старыми картинами' is the instrumental of means after the passive 'украшен'. A descriptive, slightly formal style.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a number. 'Кабинетов' is the masculine genitive plural required by 'восемь'. 'Рабочих' agrees in the genitive plural. The standard pattern for counting rooms.

missions.phrase: Я давно мечтаю о таком кабинете.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional after 'о'. 'О кабинете' uses the masculine prepositional 'кабинете' after 'о' to express dreaming about it. 'Таком' agrees in the prepositional. Good for expressing wishes.

Strategic focus: Instrumental plural after 'между'. 'Кабинетами' is the masculine instrumental plural after 'между' to show what the corridor lies between. 'Коридор' is the nominative subject. Useful for plural and layout practice.
